tei:div.tei:p: 415) yang zab dum bu'i skor las/ rmi lam rang grol gdams pa gsal ba'i sgron me bzhugs/ 416)dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ gang gi rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// rnam thar gsum ldan spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// rnam kun mchog ldan dag pa gnyis kyi bdag /dbyings la gshegs bzhugs brjod pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gags med rang gsal ye shes cho 'phrul las// sna tshogs thabs mang gang 'dul mdzad pa yi// bgrang yas chos khams rgya mtsho'i sprin du shar// yang zab man ngag rmi khrid gdams pa'i skor// skal ldan bu yi don du 'di 417)ru bstan/ de la 'dir rmi lam chos skur grol ba'i gdams pa nyams su len pa la/ gzhi khregs chod kyi lta ba ji bzhin par nyams su blangs nas lam snang rmi lam sbyong ba la/ dang po 'byung ba lnga po'i thim rim ngos bzung ba dang*/ gzhi'i 'od gsal skyon gsum dang bral bar ngo sprod pa/ khams kyi bye brag dbye zhing gegs sel ba/ 'od gsal phyi nang gi ngo bo bstan cing 'byung ba go 'phos nas gnyis med du 'gags bsdams pa'o/ de nas dang po rmi lam gnyid du phyogs pa'i tshe na sha khams sa la thim pa'i rtags 418)su lus lci zhing 'gul snying mi 'dod pa dang*/ khrag khams chu la thim pa'i rtags su kha dang sna la sogs pa'i chu rang 'byung zhing tshags mi thub pa dang*/ drod khams me la thim pa'i rtags su tsha nad kyis gdung ba bzhin mgo mjug med par drod 'bar ba/ dbugs khams rlung la thim pa'i rtags su rlung phyogs gcig tu 'dus shing dbugs 'byin 'jug gi rgyun ha cang thung la shugs drag pa/ sems khams nam mkha' la thim pa'i rtags su nyin snang gi rtog pa'i 'phro chad nas rmi snang gi yul ma mched pa'i bar du 'od gsal gyi ngo bo bzod med du 'char ba yang 'byung ngo*/ de la nyin snang gi rtog pas ma bslad rmi snang gi yul ma 'dzin nying 'khrul gyi rkyen dang bral ba'i bar du gzhi'i 'od gsal bzod med du shar ba de la yang yang goms 'dris song bas nyin mtshan 'od gsal khor yug tu grol ba'i gding rnyed do/

de'i skabs su rang bzhin pa rnams la khams kyi bye brag gis sa khams pa rnams la snang ba ser thom thom byed cing nyams ma nges pa du ma 'byung ngo*/ chu khams sa la snang ba skya rib rib 'char zhing gsal 419)nyams la sogs pa gzhan rgyud shes pa yang phran bu re 'byung*/ me khams pa la snang ba 'od dmar gyi le ba shar zhing nyams kyang rtsub cing 'gyur cha che ba'o/ rlung khams pa la snang ba 'tshubs che zhing srid pa 'jig pa dang ri nyil ba lta bu'i nyams snang 'byung*/ nam mkha'i khams la gnyid mthug cing rtog tshogs bzang ngan gang la'ang cha snyoms shing skabs rer 'od gsal dang po'i snang ba 'od kyi rnam par sngo kyi le shar ro/ lha dang bla ma'i zhal gzigs dngos med 'gro ba'i shes rgyud phran bu re mkhyen pa 'byung ngo*/ de dag gang snang thams cad rol pa dang 'phrul pa yin pas bden zhen dang spang gnyen med par rang grol du ngo shes par gyis shig sa 'byung ba kun gyi snyigs ma yin pas 'gyu cha dka' zhing ldog sla bas snang ba mi mngon cing ma nges pa'o/ chu 'byung ba kun gyi gsos lta bu yin pas 'gyu cha myur gsal dang ldan cing snang ba bzang ngan bar gsum 'gags med du 'char zhing gsal ba'o/ me 420)'byung ba kun gyi grogs lta bu yin pas phra rags kyi rtog pa thams cad mngon du byung zhing snang ba mi 'dzin par 'od gsal 'char ba'i rgyu byed do/ rlung 'byung ba kun gyi rgyu yin pas 'gyu cha shin tu 'phro sla zhing myur la tshugs mi thub cing ma nges so/ nam mkha' 'byung ba kun gyi gzhi yin pas 'gyu cha zin sla ba ldog sla ba ngal dub med par rang grol du 'gro ba'o/ de dag ngo shes shing don rtogs pa'i rmi lam gyi skabs rtog tshogs bzang ngan bar gsum thams cad la gsal sgrib med kyang yid dpyod dang bral zhing 'od gsal chos nyid kyi rang bzhin du go 'phos nas gnyis 'dzin zhen rtog thams cad thad ka rang grol du zhig pa dang*/

mthug po'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur nas bdag gzhan gnyis su med cing dbyings su zad nas chags sdang 'khrul rtog thams cad ye grol chen po'i ngang du rgya yan du gnas pas/ bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba stong rtog gnyis kyi sems zad/ gzung yul 'dzin pa bral ba'i nyin snang dang rmi snang gnyis dag mnyam du grol/ ma rig pa gzhi la mi ldan zhing rig pa rang byung gi sangs rgyas chos nyid mi 421)'gyur ba'i gding tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur ro/ 'byung ba de dag kyang tha dad du yod pa ma yin te ngo bo ye shes lnga las ma 'das shing rnam pa ye nas mtha' grol gnyis su med pa rang byung lhun rdzogs chen po ni/ sa khams ser por snang ba de shes rab stong pa yum gyi rang bzhin/ snyigs ma sa ru snang ba de thabs bde chen yab kyi rang bzhin/ chu khams dkar por snang ba de shes rab stong pa yum gyi rang bzhin/ snyigs ma chu ru snang ba de thabs bde chen yab kyi rang bzhin/ me khams dmar por snang ba de shes rab yum gyi rang bzhin/ snyigs ma me ru snang ba de thabs bde chen yab kyi rang bzhin/ rlung khams ljang gur snang ba de shes rab stong pa yum gyi rang bzhin/ snyigs ma rlung du snang ba de thabs bde chen yab kyi rang bzhin/ nam mkha'i khams mthing gar snang ba de shes rab stong pa yum gyi rang bzhin/ nam mkha' bem stong du snang ba de thabs bde chen yab kyi rang bzhin/ shes rab kyi rol pa don dam pa/ thabs kyi rol pa kun rdzob tu kha drang ba yin no/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis 'byung ba la bde zhen dang dngos por 422)bltas pas 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur du snang yang don la kha dog lnga 'byung lnga yab lnga yum lnga ye shes lnga shes rab la sogs pa thams cad ye nas gnyis med lha ru shes par bya ba gnad kyi gdams pa yin pas brtag dpyad goms 'dris kyi sgo nas nyams su len par bya'o/ de ltar gnad dang ldan na rab 'byung ba thim rim la mi ltos shing nam mkha' nam mkha' la thim pa ltar 'od gsal ka dag chos skur grol ba dang*/

'bring gis 'byung ba'i snyigs ma dwangs ma ru go 'phos nas rmi lam ngos zin cing sprul bsgyur sogs la dbang zhing longs skur grol ba dang*/ tha mas kyang 'byung ba rang ngo 'phrod nas bden med rang snang du rtogs zhing rmi lam ngan goms kyi rgyun chad cing dag pa'i snang ba lha dang dkyil 'khor zhing khams sogs mthong bar byed cing sprul skur grol bar 'gyur ro/ yang zab rmi khrid kyi man ngag rdzogs so/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ zhes pa 'di yang gter chen padma 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa'i dngos slob dam par gyur pa dge btsun chos gsal gyis yang yang bskul ngo mi ldog tsam du slob 'bangs kun gyi tha shal ba bde ba'i rdo rjes 423)gang shar rdzun ris su bris pa'o// dge'o// ha ha/ sha zin spu zin gter min gter chos 'di// jo min nag min bde ba'i ming gis bris// 'dod lugs grub mtha' mang po ngas mi shes// bka' min gter min zob chos yin yang thang*// su mi 'thad na rang gar skyur la zhog /pha gcig rtogs ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// snang srid chos skur rtogs pa'i gding zhig yod// stong gsum dgra ru ldang yang bag tsha med// 'khor 'das sgyu mar shes nas zhe blo bde// snang ba dpe ru shar ba yig ris su// 'bri bar mi 'dod kha rog nyol la sdod// shog brdzad sprang mos gang shar bris pa dge/ ha ha ha// 424)
